workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.FILE_NOT_FOUND: Upload the file again because the stored upload could not be found.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.FILE_UNREADABLE: Save the spreadsheet again as a clean UTF-8 CSV or standard .xlsx workbook and upload it.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.FILE_CORRUPTED: Export a fresh copy of the file because the uploaded archive or stream is corrupted.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.FILE_EMPTY: Add a header row and at least one data row to the file before uploading.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.FILE_TYPE_MISMATCH: Make sure the file contents match its .csv or .xlsx extension.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.FILE_TOO_LARGE: Split the file so it stays within 16 MB for CSV or 8 MB for Excel.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED: Re-save the CSV file using UTF-8 encoding and upload it again.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.SHEET_NOT_FOUND: Place the import table on the first worksheet of the Excel workbook.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.EMPTY_SHEET: Add a header row and data rows to the first worksheet before uploading.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.HEADER_MISSING: Add the expected column headers to the first row of the file.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.HEADER_DUPLICATE: Rename duplicate column headers in the first row so each column name is unique.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.MAPPING_HEADER_MISMA: Update the first row of the file so its column names and positions match the mapping.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.COLUMN_COUNT_EXCEEDE: Remove extra unused columns so the file has 200 columns or fewer.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.ROW_COUNT_EXCEEDED: Split the spreadsheet into batches of 10,000 data rows or fewer per upload.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.DUPLICATE_STABLE_KEY: Remove or merge duplicate item/branch key rows so each row is unique.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.REQUIRED_COLUMN_MISS: Include every required column defined by the selected import mapping.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.CELL_TYPE_INVALID: Replace formulas or unsupported cell objects with plain text, numbers, or Yes/No values.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.OWNER_BATCH_REJECTED: Review the referenced codes and company permissions in the file, then run the check again.
workerErrors.WORKER.TRADE_IMPORT.EXECUTION_TIMEOUT: Split the file into smaller batches and start a new import run.
